key.name: rom-folders
key.description: Folders searched for machine ROMs after the bundled ROM sets and the data folder's roms folder.

key.name: data-folder
key.description: The folder where MAME keeps its files. Empty for $XDG_DATA_HOME/pinesy.

key.name: debugger
key.description: What Run with Debugger uses: MAME's debugger ("windows"), or the GDB remote stub ("gdbStub").

key.name: gdb-port
key.description: The port the GDB remote stub listens on.

key.name: pi-gdb-port
key.description: The port the Pi's GDB stub (QEMU) listens on, in a run with the debugger of a configuration with a Pi SD card.

key.name: start-paused
key.description: In a run with the debugger, the Next waits at its first instruction until it is continued.

key.name: update-checks
key.description: A CI build looks for a newer build of its track at startup. Never Remind Again in the out-of-date notice turns this off.

key.name: ignored-build
key.description: The build that Never Remind for This Version ignores: a version, or a Flatpak commit. Empty for none.
